servers.name: semantic-scholar
servers.description: Semantic Scholar literature MCP server installed from the semantic-scholar-skills repository for paper triage, citations, recommendations, and snippets.

tools.name: paper_snippets
tools.description: Pull snippet-level evidence around a concept or phrase.
